name: streamdex
description: An experiment in ways of working with agentic workflows using Stream Deck+ and Mobile
author: Streamdex

scripts.test:fast: vitest run --project unit && node scripts/test-custom.mjs fast
scripts.test:tasks: vitest run --project unit test/agent-navigator.test.ts test/focused-target.test.ts test/live-approval-status.test.ts test/local-store.integration.test.ts test/rollout-status.test.ts test/render-cache.test.ts test/session-status-colors.test.ts && node scripts/test-custom.mjs tasks
scripts.test:voice: vitest run test/dictation-lifecycle.test.ts test/input-release-guard.test.ts test/ptt-guard.test.ts && node scripts/test-custom.mjs voice
scripts.check:quick: npm run typecheck && npm run check:docs && npm test
scripts.check:full: npm run typecheck && npm run check:docs && npm run test:audit && npm run build && npm run pack && npm run check:version && npm run test:all && npm run audit:local
